description: Implementation of NgHttp2Adapter class for HTTP/2 communication using nghttp2 library, including methods for session management, data submission, and stream control.

classes.name: SelfDeletingMetadataSource
classes.description: A MetadataSource that deletes itself upon completion or failure.

classes.name: NgHttp2Adapter
classes.description: Class implementing HTTP/2 session management and data transfer using nghttp2 library.

methods.name: CreateClientAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new NgHttp2Adapter instance configured as a client.

methods.name: CreateServerAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new NgHttp2Adapter instance configured as a server.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Checks if the current session is a server session.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes for the session.

methods.name: SubmitSettings
methods.description: Submits HTTP/2 settings to the session.

methods.name: SubmitPriorityForStream
methods.description: Submits priority information for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitPing
methods.description: Sends a PING frame.

methods.name: SubmitShutdownNotice
methods.description: Sends a shutdown notice.

methods.name: SubmitGoAway
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: SubmitWindowUpdate
methods.description: Updates flow control window for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitMetadata
methods.description: Submits metadata frames.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends pending frames.

methods.name: GetSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the remote window size.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the send window size for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Returns the receive window limit for a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the receive window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the local receive window size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the HPACK encoder dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the HPACK decoder dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the highest stream ID received.

methods.name: MarkDataConsumedForStream
methods.description: Marks data as consumed for flow control.

methods.name: SubmitRst
methods.description: Resets a stream with an error code.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits a new request with headers and optional data.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits a response with headers and optional data.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Submits trailers for a stream.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a paused stream.

methods.name: RemoveStream
methods.description: Removes a stream from management.

methods.name: NgHttp2Adapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with visitor, perspective, and options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the nghttp2 session with options.
